testcase.name: SSH authorization expiring during endpoint review fails before an HTTP request
approved custom credential providers cannot inject unsafe HTTP headers
HTTP SSH authorization validates server output before review and uses only fresh ephemeral headers
HTTP actions retain signed queries but HTTPS batches cannot downgrade
derived endpoint receives scoped credentials while repository supplied foreign endpoints do not
invalid signed action address never leaks its token in the error
approved custom endpoint authorizes only that repository and receives no inherited Git secret
expired authorization unsupported numeric sizes duplicate JSON and deep responses fail closed
named remote LFS settings do not inherit origin overrides
action addresses reject insecure schemes credentials traversal fragments and header injection
custom endpoint credentials are requested only after approval and never borrow Git credentials
explicit push endpoint has its own scope and cannot inherit download credentials
